core_obligations: Write $f_*\mathcal{F}$ as a filtered colimit of coherent modules, upgrade them to finitely presented modules, and note that their pullbacks are finitely presented (proof lines 2906-2914).

Prove that the canonical map $\colim f^*\mathcal{H}_i = f^*f_*\mathcal{F} \to \mathcal{F}$ is surjective: choose a surjective etale $V \to Y$ with $V$ a scheme, set $U = X \times_Y V$, and use base change to identify the restriction of the map with the surjective map $(f')^*f'_*(\mathcal{F}|_U) \to \mathcal{F}|_U$ for the affine morphism of schemes $f'$ (proof lines 2915-2933).

Conclude that $\mathcal{F}$ is the cokernel of a map between filtered colimits of finitely presented modules, and for every index $j$ choose a stage $i$ and a morphism $\alpha : \mathcal{G}_j \to \mathcal{H}_i$ compatible with the colimit maps (proof lines 2935-2953).

Show that the set $K$ of triples $(i, j, \alpha)$ is directed under the natural order, with the cokernels $\Coker(\alpha)$ finitely presented and mapping to $\mathcal{F}$, and that $\mathcal{F} = \colim_{(i,j,\alpha) \in K} \Coker(\alpha)$ (proof lines 2954-2972).
proof_roadmap: The system of finitely presented modules (proof lines 2906-2914).
Surjectivity of $f^*f_*\mathcal{F} \to \mathcal{F}$ on an etale cover (proof lines 2915-2933).
Presentation of $\mathcal{F}$ as a cokernel and choice of the factorisations $\alpha$ (proof lines 2935-2953).
The directed set of triples and the conclusion (proof lines 2954-2972).
difficulty_reason: The lemma expresses every quasi-coherent module on an affine space over a Noetherian base as a filtered colimit of finitely presented modules (statement lines 2897-2903). The proof pulls back a filtered system of coherent modules approximating the pushforward, uses affineness (checked on an etale cover, where the statement is the classical one for schemes) to show that the counit is surjective, and then manufactures the colimit description from cokernels of maps between the approximating modules, checking that the indexing set of triples is directed. The construction of the directed system is the substance, so the claim is H2.
